# TauLeap

> Small, local-first tools for your Mac and your browser.

TauLeap is an independent software project building lightweight macOS desktop apps and Chrome extensions that run locally on your machine with no required account and no usage telemetry.

- Website: https://tauleap.com/
- Contact: support@tauleap.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/tau-leap

## Featured Mac Apps

- [TauSQL](https://tauleap.com/product/tausql/): Imports local CSV, TSV, and Parquet files into DuckDB so you can query and analyze them with SQL offline; also opens external `.duckdb` files and connects to remote DuckDB 2.0 Quack / DuckLake endpoints. OS: macOS (Apple Silicon). Pricing: 10-day full trial, then Core stays free; Pro is $2.99/mo, $24.99/yr, or $49.99 lifetime (up to 2 devices).
- [TauBar](https://tauleap.com/product/taubar/): Window-level taskbar for macOS that shows each open window with its title, pinned apps, Start menu, clock and calendar, Chrome profile indicators, ⌥Tab Window Switcher across Spaces, and drag shelf. OS: macOS 26 (Tahoe) or later, Apple Silicon only (not Intel Macs or macOS 15 and earlier). Pricing: 10-day full trial, then core taskbar stays free; Pro is $0.99/mo, $9.99/yr, or $19.99 lifetime (up to 2 Macs).
- [TauBar (Japanese)](https://tauleap.com/product/taubar/ja/): Japanese product page for TauBar (macOS 26+ / Apple Silicon).
- [TauBar Alternatives Comparison](https://tauleap.com/product/taubar/alternatives/): Honest comparison of macOS window-level taskbars — TauBar vs uBar, Tungsten Edge, Winstrix, and DockDoor, including requirements, pricing, and who TauBar is not for.
- [TauBar Alternatives Comparison (Japanese)](https://tauleap.com/product/taubar/ja/alternatives/): Japanese comparison of TauBar vs uBar, Tungsten Edge, Winstrix, and DockDoor.

## Other Mac Apps

- [TauPad](https://tauleap.com/product/taupad/): Fast-launching local text editor with multi-tab editing, UTF-8 / Shift_JIS encoding and LF / CRLF line-ending support, regex find/replace, and GFM Markdown preview. OS: macOS 10.15+ (Apple Silicon). Pricing: Free.
- [TauDiff](https://tauleap.com/product/taudiff/): Focused two-pane side-by-side text diff tool where both panes remain editable, preserving character encodings (UTF-8, Shift_JIS, EUC-JP) and line endings on save. OS: macOS 10.15+ (Apple Silicon). Pricing: Free.

## Chrome Extensions

- [GitHub Translate (Chrome Web Store)](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/github-translate/ignplaeoffkjaffgbhclflhmegllfipm): Displays short Japanese labels beside github.com menus, tabs, and buttons for Japanese users. OS: Chrome. Pricing: Free.
- [GitHub Translate Feedback](https://tauleap.com/product/github-translate/feedback/): Issue templates and feedback guide for GitHub Translate.
- [TauMemo (Chrome Web Store)](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/taumemo/khojmfmcimbohoejfgnegfgdilehlhbj): Chrome Side Panel memo extension that auto-saves notes locally on your device with no account or cloud sync. OS: Chrome. Pricing: Free.
